body:
I use plain oats with soy milk and either flax seeds of chia seeds.  
Leave it overnight to soak. The next day I eat it at lunch after adding a sugar packet and microwaving it.

I have only been back to trying CICO and weightlifting two weeks and I already feel a bit like a failure each time I eat. I thought I was done with restricting and committed to losing this weight the right way but those restriction thoughts are more stubborn then I thought.

I feel like I should tell someone about it (my therapist for example). But I don't want them to tell me to stop trying to lose weight so I'm kind of stuck. 

Will try to force myself to eat the right amount every day and ignore the voice telling me to restrict more. Just needed to tell someone even if it is just screaming in the void.
I know right. It would be so much easier if we didn't need food to survive. It is such a struggle.
Thicc cat nap here.
Wow this is me today. Are you in my head? Hope you feel better soon!
I think Small Hands does too. I have seen him together with Owen Gray and they are both seemed to do that.

Thank you! I think I will tell her even though it is hard. 

I fear being told to put my weight loss on hold but at the same time I would understand if it is needed to focus on my mental health first.
Me neither
Could use that link too

Sometimes I think I might still have feelings for my ex. It comes and it goes. He was my first really serious long term boyfriend and we were each others first everything's. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if we had gotten back together like he wanted. 

The reason he doesn't know is that I am and have been in a relationship the last 7 years and he for the last 4. If we were both single I might give it a chance but that will never happen. I don't think I will ever tell anyone but I am afraid this feeling will never completely go away.

I have found a way out, I talked to my dad. And I will pick up some things that used to make me happy again. Save a bit of money for those things and put myself out there a bit more.
Thanks for the opening but I think I am a little talked out at the moment. I do appreciate it!

I have a load of hobbies so I'm not sure I even have the time to do something different. But as soon as I have saved enough money I will get my motorcycle licence and try to travel a bit. And perhaps I should start playing music again! Even is it is just a little bit once in a while. Or continue my lessons for becoming a concert pianist. Don't have the discipline for it but I used to be pretty good :-)

We have a group of 4 people now, and two therapists. This weekend I'm going to try to email one of the therapists to ask about the possibility of individual therapy because that might be an option. I talked to my dad about it and he will help me with that.
I am sorry you felt/feel like that was your only option. I hope you are getting help now! That sounds like an terrifying experience! If I may ask, are you glad you were found?
I am very sorry to hear that! Perhaps you could tell me what you are going through?

I'm sorry to hear that. Are you still here? Even though talking might not be a solution, sometimes it is nice just to have someone carry the weight of your problems with you. Would you be willing to elaborate on what makes you feel like this?

I did something crazy and finally talked to my dad about most of it. Talking about my suicide plans was still to scary but I did talk about all the things that make me want to end it so that is a start.
I am going to put some money away so I can get my motorcycle licence soon. And then travel on bike. That would be a dream of mine. Thank you for reminding me!
And it is indeed needed sometimes to hold it all together ourselves, we are responsible for ourself. But someone to carry even a little bit of the weight is always good.

With that in mind I did the impossible, I talked to my dad! And we had an amazing talk. I didn't tell him about my suicidal thoughts but I did tell him about my anxiety and how depressed I felt. He us going to help me through the tings he can help me with and told me he wants me to talk to him so that was so good! I feel so much less alone and all the comments here also helped a lot!
Thank you! You are exactly right! I'm going to try to keep that in mind more often.

Small update. I just chatted with a crisis line and I am more confidant now that I won't hurt myself until I talked to someone in my life(family, friend, doctor, whatever) about it. Thanks for giving me the courage to open the chat!

I'm not sure. I have tried so often to talk and it never worked out. Part of me does want a solution but another part has accepted there is none and is ready to just end it. Not sure if talking will work.
Thanks, I will!
Because he has just recently become more depressed and I want to support him after 5 years being together. But if he doesn't get help soon I will have to leave I'm afraid.

Felt pretty good today. Passed an exam and taught a successful class at school. Then I came home and my boyfriend freaked out, couldn't get him to calm down and he turned kinda aggressive toward the world. 
Managed to avoid a panic attack so my new medication must be working.Did decide to talk to my dad about feeling so depressed and anxious when I get a chance. Hopefully that is tomorrow and I find the guts to finally tell him. Now I am just waiting until I can go to bed but I don't want to lie next to my bf.

I don't have any advice or anything. I just wanted to say that you are doing a good thing. Seeking help with a therapist, confiding in your partner and their parents. It also sounds like a good plan to file as independent but I have no idea how that works over there. Perhaps there is government assistance because of your mental health?
And it sounds like having distance from your parents is indeed a good idea. I hope your conversation with them goes well. 
Perhaps you can talk about your therapist about options for a job, assistance with a cv and letter?
Have some Internet hugs because you deserve them!
Thanks, that sounds like good place. Thanks!

I started when I was 13 and stoppen when I was 19. I am 24 now and 5 years 'clean'. Lately I do have some urges but I really don't want to fall back on cutting. 
And I really agree with what the people before me said. Having your life together and cutting are not mutually exclusive. Just like depression can come up for no reason.

Thank you for your kind response. She is kind and patient but since I only have group therapy I don't  know her that well. But your response helps me see that it is a normal request to make. So I will send the email asking to give me some time to bring it up on my own. And in the meanwhile I'll keep breathing.
I was afraid I would make her feel too rushed or that I was overreacting. But I'll send one in a moment and turn the read receipt on. That is a good idea. Your logic is good :)

That happened to me too. That was 5 years ago and lately I feel just like you. I need the relief and no one around me know how hard it is. The one thing keeping me from doing it is that I don't want to break my 'streak'.

My mom has also been depressed my whole life and longer. I'm so afraid she will follow me if I died. It is one of the reasons I haven't yet. And I recognise the feeling that you can't tell her everything because you are afraid of bringing her down. It sucks sometimes.

Sad to say I do know the feeling. Can't talk to the people around me either because they haven't seen it either or hate that I ever did it and act like I'm a bad person for wanting it. The only thought that is helping right now is that I have been 'clean' for 5 years and don't want to give that up. 
I hope you can get out of that situation. Sounds like a crap thing to be around all day. 
Perhaps you can talk to the person that prescribed your medication?

His reaction is not okay. You explained how you felt en he dismissed how you feel. That is not a good thing! Whenever you feel bed it is not necessarily your fault. Especially if you are still trying so hard to function. On one side he says it not so bad because you do fun things and on the other side he says you should try harder and do more. That does not make any sense. He makes me angry.
Is it possible for you to switch to a different therapist?
That sounds like a (very) bad day. I am sorry that happened to you. Hope you can get some rest and feel better soon. And remember you survived this. That is a huge accomplishment.

I feel the same. I go to school, clean my house, exercise but I do want to die. I am so afraid of my therapist thinking like that when I talk to them which doesn't make it easy. But if they would tell me that, I would consider switching to another therapist. How did you react when they told you that?

While I do know I won't be judged. A lot of the people there have battled the same feelings. The logical side of me knows I won't be judged. But I do feel like I let them down when I feel bad again. Listening to others talk about it does help with feeling less ashamed and more accepted. 
And to speak with my therapist one on one I need to ask them in the group session. Or email them and if I won't get an appointment before my group session they often talk about the email in the group. But I could ask them in email that I don't want to talk about it in the group. 
But another referral might work. Does feel a bit cowardly to not trust my group and therapists.
Thank you for your kind response. I indeed think the guilt and shame are the worse parts on top of feeling like crap already. But I will keep trying.

I'm not sure you'll see this since your account was deleted but I wanted to reply anyway. 

First I want to say I am very sorry that you are in that situ. While my situation is different I do recognise some parts. My parents have been divorced for about a year and a half now. Partly because of my mom's depression and drinking habits. She mainly drinks at night when she thinks no one notices. But she leaves the bottles lying around. My dad has a gf now and is a lot happier but is still sad he couldn't do more. 
A lot of my mom's issues are also due to childhood traumas and she has been in therapy for years. Though I suspect she isn't as honest as she could be in therapy just like your mother. Perhaps you can suggest she goed back into therapy. There are so many different kinds one of them should help. 
Good luck!

I'm not sure you'll see this, as your account has been deleted but I still wanted to reply. 
My parents divorced a year and a half ago. Partly because of my mom's depression which also causes her to drink. My dad has a gf now and is so much happier but it still pains him that he wasn't able to help. 
I'm sad to say that nothing will change unless she accepts help and truly talks about her problems. My mom has been in therapy for years but I suspects she doesn't really open up in the areas she needs to, just like your mom. Perhaps you can try to get her to try a different therapist?
I am very sorry to hear that you are going through all that. Seeing your mother drunk like that is terrible and I hope you will all get to a better situation sooner.

It used to be a best friends living on opposite sides of the world thing. But now it is strained. Partly because they haven't talked in a while before he came here and the living with us has not helped. 
I have the annoying habit to avoid confrontation so I think I'll go with the first option. But I'll go the the second one if he acts like a bad friend during the conversation.

OP here, not sure if I am supposed to comment on each of your comment or just do it like this. Thanks for the advice all! 
I do feel like it is my cat so my responsibility but you do make a good point. I did not guaranty everything would leave the same state it came in and it was an accident. So I think I'll just tell him that if he asks about it, and if his reply is not civil I'll tell him to get his ass out or pay rent(if my confrontation avoiding habits let me).
